metadata.description: Compute-side MiniMax-M3 cases selected from the supplied trace and breakdown; ATOM provides kernel implementations and native accuracy tests.

workload_source.configuration: TP4, FP8 KV, MXFP4 MoE, EAGLE3 K3; decode B32 x Q4 with indexer CP4; prefill Q2763, prefix157312, KV160075.
workload_source.attribution: Kernel selection and workload shapes are derived from the trace and breakdown. The ATOM commit above identifies the later implementation used for standalone reproduction, not the original trace software. Input values are synthetic; this is not an end-to-end trace replay.

correctness_tests.scope: Reuse upstream accuracy/parity tests; their parameter sets differ from these three extracted trace-shape cases. CP exchange is simulated on one GPU, not a four-GPU transport test.

validation.scope: The two unmodified upstream UT files; parameter sets differ from the three extracted workload shapes.

metadata.selection_rule: Useful work / estimated logical bytes > compute reference / HBM reference. Compute-side roofline classification is not proof of an observed compute bottleneck. Integer compare counts are separate from FLOPs.
metadata.runtime_setup: Use the pinned ATOM/AITER checkouts on PYTHONPATH in a compatible ROCm PyTorch environment and select one gfx1250 GPU.

minimax-m3.model_attribution: Kernel selection and shapes originate from the MiniMax-M3 trace and breakdown listed in metadata.workload_source; ATOM is the implementation source.

kernels.label: MiniMax-M3 Prefill index score

roofline.work_definition: 2 * head_dim * sum(prefix + row + 1 for each query row); excludes masked dot positions and non-dot work
roofline.byte_definition: Logical tensor read/write proxy, not measured HBM traffic; cache reuse and repeated physical reads are not inferred.

performance.measurement: Median of three process means; 10,000 target dispatches/process. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace device timestamps, with unmodified AITER rotating buffers and CUDA graph replay. Setup, independent oracles and warmup excluded.
performance.scope: One native target kernel per invocation; packed_topk includes sparse page emission but excludes score generation.
performance.correctness_scope: Historical rotating-buffer baseline checks; the simplified extraction command delegates accuracy tests to upstream ATOM.
performance.baseline_correctness: 16 query rows, all valid context blocks against FP32 FP8-query scoring; reduced full UT and composed-wrapper parity also passed.

notes: Shapes and kernel attribution come from metadata.workload_source; triton.source points to the implementation.
Run the upstream UT command separately from IR extraction. The runner contains no copied kernel bodies or accuracy oracles.
The extraction command launches one target kernel; packed-topk score generation is setup only. Reference timings are from the earlier rotating-buffer profiler experiment.

workload_evidence.shape_mapping: Prefill Q/context/head_dim follows breakdown row7; packed top-k consumes that score tensor. Decode reproduces B32 x Q4, CP4, using representative context194048 for the approximately 194K trace workload.

extraction_validation.scope: Trace-shape target-only IR extraction; native UTs are recorded separately in metadata.correctness_tests.
